title: Bechet with Buddy Petit and Peter Bocage on violin
summary: Bechet played at a cabaret with Buddy Petit's five-piece; Bocage played violin and was on the other side of the street.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, the only band I see Bichet was playing with Bollipetite. They was playing at the cabaret and I used to pass there some nights. You know, Mr. Passage, he was playing at the, I mean Bollipetite had about five pieces. Murray and, Murray and, Ben. See, but in other words they had bands all on Bayesian streets too, you know. Yeah, they had bands all on Bayesian streets. Every colony had a cabaret, then they had bands all around. At 25, band 25 and 28. Band on both sides of the street.
Who would be at 25 and 28? Juar was playing there.

At which? Juar was playing there. And, and Peter Bocard was playing there. Peter Bocard was, uh, yeah, he, uh, after he left 25, they went play for, um, Murray and, uh, in Appleville. For Pete Lawler. Uh huh.
What was Peter Bocard's playing then? What is?
He was playing violin then. I remember he was playing violin then. Uh huh. He was playing violin.
